name: Padh practice writer
description: Drafts a short practice text in Telugu, Hindi or English around the aksharas a child misread. Code picks the targets and code checks every draft (script, length, familiar words, target coverage) before a child sees it.
dataAccess: target words and aksharas chosen by the scoring engine
no child data: only target words reach the model
actions: text only; every draft is checked in code before use
